Requirement: Sending push notifications to students at 11:30 AM with discounts on the daily special.

Why it is vague: The target audience parameters are not defined. Sending a daily mass push notification to the entire student body could be flagged as spam and cause app uninstalls. It is unclear if this should only target users physically on campus (geofencing), users who explicitly opt-in to marketing, or recent active users.
